items.name: AI assistants
items.text: Assistants that answer questions from an organisation's own documents, such as MIND at the LEGO Group and AskEIVA.

items.name: Automation
items.text: Apps and automated workflows on the Power Platform, including 15+ apps and 50+ flows at the LEGO Group.

items.name: Security basics
items.text: Structured threat modelling to find weak points early. I also teach it through Open Door, a classroom game.

items.name: Web development
items.text: Web apps from the database to the user interface, such as Coursebot in Laravel and Vue.

items.name: Business cases
items.text: Weighing costs, benefits and risks of new technology, as in the generative AI business case for a LEGO design team.

items.name: Stakeholder work
items.text: Agreed a release process for Power Platform apps with stakeholders, and managed a process split between two departments.

items.name: Leading people
items.text: Supervises AI-focused MSc projects, currently three. Earlier led a tutor team and chaired IDA Event Herning.

items.name: Teaching
items.text: Taught master's students to build AI business cases with 33A AI Cards®. Rated 4.9 / 5 by students in Web Technologies.
